info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Facility Equipment Administration-spec
info.description: The Facility Equipment Administration API facilitates the management and configuration of equipment within banking facilities. This service allows users to register new equipment, modify existing records, and streamline administrative tasks associated with facility resources. It is primarily targeted at facility managers and operations personnel who need to ensure that their equipment inventory is up-to-date and properly documented. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance operational efficiency and improve resource allocation across their locations.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new entry in the equipment administration system, enabling effective management and tracking of equipment within facilities.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update equipment administration details within the facilities system. Ensure that all required fields are populated according to the defined schema.
